technique_name: Describe how blockchain technology can be used to improve data security
description: Blockchain technology can be used to improve data security by creating an immutable and secure record of transactions. Through the use of cryptographic algorithms, blockchain is able to securely store and transfer data without a central authority. It is nearly impossible to tamper with or alter the data stored in a blockchain, as the entire system is protected by a distributed network of computers.
